svg.title: iOS · Capture — Interval · Ladder picker · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/LightLadderViews.swift (LadderPickerSheet), presented from the ladder chip in App/CaptureDials.swift (IntervalDialsRow.ladderChip → onSelectLadder) via CaptureView's ladderChrome. A medium-detent sheet (.medium/.large, drag indicator) over the dimmed capture screen, white: title "Ladder" 20 bold with "Manage" 15 semibold in LL.amber trailing; then the store's ladders — the built-in first, each row = 26 pt LadderSwatch (the ladder's own rungs as a vertical gradient, amber → accent → accentDeep → ink), name 16, subtitle 11.5 secondary ("Built in · 4 rungs · EV 13 · 8 · 4 · darker"; user ladders drop the "Built in ·"), a checkmark in LL.amber on the selected one; rows 13 pt padded with a 38 pt-inset divider between them. Picking dismisses and arms that ladder for the next Ladder shoot (nil = the built-in); Manage dismisses and opens Interval ladders (interval-ladders.portrait.svg) — the sheet never edits. Footer 11.5 secondary. Drawn with the built-in alone; a user ladder would follow as a second row. Same medium sheet on iPad (the chip lives inside the Equatable dial row, which a popover anchor would have to reach through) — a noted deviation from the handoff's popover. Staged by LL_LADDER=picker with LL_CAPTURE=1.

g.text: Manage opens Interval ladders, where a ladder can be duplicated,
edited or deleted. Picking one here only arms it.
